item_short_desc: Rothco’s officially-licensed United States Navy Flag features the iconic eagle, globe, and anchor design and makes a great gift for sailors, veterans, or anybody looking to showcase their patriotism.
description: Rothco’s US Navy Flag measures 3’ x 5’ and is made of a durable, double stitched polyester material. It also features grommets along the side for easy display. This military flag is officially licensed by the United States Navy.
